== Damage Values ==

=== Damage Calculation ===
To understand how health and damage work, the following concepts are needed:
* <b>[[#Health_Values_and_Damage_Modifiers|Enemy HP]]</b>: Each enemy has a certain amount of health.
* <b>[[#Needle|Weapon Damage]]</b>: Each weapon has a base-damage that it would deal on its own.
* <b>[[#Health_Values_and_Damage_Modifiers|Enemy-specific Modifiers]]</b>: Each enemy has a set of 5 values. Generally, one of these values is used to change the amount of damage taken from a hit, depending on the level of the attacking weapon. More specifically, the relevant level is almost always the level of the thing that would need to be upgraded to change the damage of the attack, i.e. the [[Crafting Kit]] for [[Tools]], and [[Needle]] upgrades for Needle hits, [[Silk Skills]] and similar.
* <b>[[#Modifiers|Other Modifiers]]</b>: There are numerous other things that can modify damage taken, e.g. [[Barbed Bracelet]] or effects of certain [[Crests]].
* <b>Bonus Damage</b>: A few things like poison from the [[Pollip Pouch]] do not contribute to direct damage from the initial hit, instead dealing their own bonus damage. Bonus damage generally does not scale with upgrades and is unaffected by all modifiers. 
* <b>Rounding</b>: Silksong generally applies “round to even” rounding, meaning damage values are rounded to the nearest whole number, with .5 values going to the nearest even number. However, not all cases follow this rule—for example, the follow-up damage from [[Threefold Pin]] and [[Silkshot|Silkshot (Twelfth Architect)]] rounds down instead.


It is worth noting that the same type of enemy can have different health and damage modifiers in different circumstances. E.g. a summoned enemy in a bossfight may have different stats from the same enemy encountered outside of the bossfight.

==== Formula ====
<pre>
total_damage = weapon_damage[weapon_level] * enemy_modifiers[weapon_level] * player_modifiers
</pre>

==== Examples ====
Hornet has one Needle upgrade, and has Barbed Bracelet equipped. She hits an enemy that has a level 1 modifier of 0.8.

<pre>
total_damage =
    9    [Needle damage at level 1]
  * 0.8  [Enemy modifier for level 1 attack]
  * 1.25 [Barbed Bracelet]
  = 9 damage
</pre>

Hornet has Fully Evolved [[Hunter Crest|Hunter's Crest]], Enhanced Focus, all Needle upgrades, [[Barbed Bracelet]], activated [[Flintslate]], and has just used [[Challenge]]. She performs a Needle Strike against an enemy with a level 4 modifier of 1.

<pre>
total_damage = 
    29 [Needle Strike damage at level 4]
  * 1  [Enemy modifier for level 4 attack]
  * ( 1      [ Additional Modifiers ]
      + 0.3  [Focus]
      + 0.2  [Enhanced Focus]
      + 0.25 [Barbed Bracelet]
      + 0.5  [Flintslate]
      + 0.5  [Challenge]
    )
  = 79.75 [Round to Even -> Round Up]
  = 80 damage

total_damage [1st Hit] = 80 damage
  = 29 * 1 * 2.75 = 79.75 [Round to Even -> Round Up]

total_damage [2nd Hit] = 65 damage
  = 29 * 1 * 2.25 = 65.25 [Round to Even -> Round Down]
</pre>
